newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish firms show Jan-June PLN 6.0 bln net profit.
newsitem.headline: Polish firms show Jan-June PLN 6.0 bln net profit.

text.p: Polish enterprises reported an overall 6.0 billion zloty net profit in the January-June period, compared with a 5.1 billion zloty net profit in the same period of 1996, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
GUS said the private sector had a net profit of 3.6 billion zlotys on total revenues of 170.8 billion in the period against a profit of 2.5 billion and revenues of 118.6 in the same period last year.
The state-owned sector reported a profit of 2.4 billion on revenues of 143.6 billion versus last year's 2.5 billion and 128.1 billion respectively.
NOTES: Data collected from all companies employing more than 50 people in main sectors of the economy.
Liquidity ratio is a percentage relation of cash reserves and tradable securities to short-term liabilities.
